verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a managed vector database, so the axis applies. The pack only documents backups of serverless indexes for protecting, copying, or experimenting with indexes inside Pinecone. That is an adjacent feature, not an export of all data in open formats to leave the platform. No export tool, open-format dump, or migration path is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
